Maya (Product): Heads up — FinReg wants an "Evidence Kit" in Console: per-tenant cost deltas by route (7d/30d) + a downloadable signed/redacted bundle auditors can use. They expect an attestation and chain-of-custody. We need to decide scope for a Q2 pilot.
Zoe (Eng): Tech constraints first: exact per-token lineage isn't feasible yet with current kv-cache/quantization; proposal: estimated cost per-request (input_length heuristic * cost_per_token) + deterministic sampled bundles.
Caleb (SRE): Ops note: main cost drivers are retention and outbound exports. Recommend hot UI index 7d, archive bundles 90d, default sampling 0.75% (tenant override). For pilot keep tenant opt-in and export size limited (<=1000 traces).
Rina (Compliance): Redaction must be provable. Plan: run redaction before any persistent write, emit redaction metadata (rule_id, version, match_count) and include that in manifest.json inside the bundle. No raw PII persisted. Signed attestation should reference redaction ruleset version.
Ben (Customer Success): I'll confirm FinReg preferred format — they said Parquet is ideal for their pipelines but CSV is fine. Also confirm whether they need scheduled exports or only on-demand.
Zoe (Eng): Implementation sketch: ingress tags tenant_id+route_id+estimate_token_count -> deterministic sampler (seed = tenant_id+date) -> stream to async pipeline -> redaction service (emit metadata) -> short-term store -> export job builds bundle (parquet/csv + manifest.json) -> sign bundle (KMS HMAC) -> provide download link. Pseudoconfig snippet: 
```
evidence_kit:
  sampling_rate: 0.0075
  ui_index_days: 7
  archive_days: 90
  max_export_traces: 1000
  redaction_rules_version: "2026-03-15"
```
Maya (Product): MVP cuts I'm proposing: 1) estimated per-route cost (7d view) not token-level billing, 2) deterministic sampled bundles with pre-storage redaction, 3) signed export with manifest, 4) tenant opt-in pilot (single customer). Launch criteria: pilot can export signed bundle + manifest, attestation generated, and no >2% p99 regression. Thoughts? :thinking_face:
Caleb (SRE): Keep pipeline async to avoid tail latency. Add backpressure: drop samples when consumer lag > 30s and emit metric. SLO: sampling pipeline must not add >5ms p99 when off-path. Also will model cost for default sampling across 1M requests.
Rina (Compliance): Include CI redaction tests and a weekly verification job that re-scans stored bundles and emits a compliance report. Manifest must include rule checksums and redaction job version.
Ben (Customer Success): I'll gather FinReg schema + acceptance criteria (due Thu EOD). Also ask if they require signed attestations or formal letters.
UI-bot: Uploaded a compact mock: "Evidence Kit tile" -> modal with heatmap (per-route delta), small sample table, "Request Evidence Bundle" button, tenant + date selector. Minimal filters for MVP.
Zoe (Eng): Effort estimate: spike + POC = 1 sprint, pilot infra + export flow + console stubs = 2 more sprints. With single-tenant pilot and export limits we can be in ~3 sprints. Risks: redaction false negatives, sampling bias for small tenants, storage blowouts if sampling misconfigured. Will include rollback toggle to disable sampling.
Maya (Product): Prioritization: this edges up because it's tied to a renewal. We may defer some model-cost features. Action items: 1) Ben collect FinReg schema + acceptance (Thu EOD), 2) Zoe write short design doc + failure modes (next Tue), 3) UI-bot finalize mock (Wed), 4) Rina outline compliance checklist + CI tests (Wed), 5) Caleb produce retention/cost estimate + SLOs (Wed). I'll schedule a 30m design sync after docs.
deploy-bot: Flag created: feature/evidence-kit :white_check_mark:
Maya (Product): If design passes we'll target a Q2 single-tenant pilot. Success metrics: signed bundle export (Parquet preferred), manifest + redaction report present, bundle generation <30s for <=1k traces, console tile rendering <200ms, and no >2% p99 regressions. Thanks team.
Zoe (Eng): I'll call out mitigations (deterministic sampler, tenant opt-in, exporter quotas) and a rollback plan (kill sampler + revoke links).
Caleb (SRE): Adding ops runbook for expired bundles and manual export support.
Maya (Product): Great. Closing thread until PRs show up.
